description: This file defines the MathInternalError class, a specific exception used within the Apache Commons Math library to indicate internal errors that should not happen. It extends the MathIllegalStateException class and provides constructors for different error reporting scenarios.

classes.name: MathInternalError
classes.description: A runtime exception indicating an unexpected internal error within the math library. Extends MathIllegalStateException and adds an URL for reporting issues.

methods.name: MathInternalError()
methods.description: Default constructor that adds an internal error message with a report URL.

methods.name: MathInternalError(Throwable cause)
methods.description: Constructor that wraps a root cause Throwable, passing it along with a localized message.

methods.name: MathInternalError(Localizable pattern, Object... args)
methods.description: Constructor accepting a localized message pattern and arguments for detailed error description.
